assessment_scope: Repository Compose/Helm default application profiles and the local built image; no live deployment audit. No Trivy suppressions.

evidence: app has no mount/nsenter/libmount call path
high_assessment.residual: libmount and other util-linux libraries retain the affected version; privileged/custom invocation is outside this assessment

evidence: reported defect is in progs/infocmp.c analyze_string
high_assessment.residual: ncurses Essential packages retained; version-based records remain

evidence: systemd-homed absent from PATH and standard lib/systemd locations
app does not run systemd services
no libacl/API/subprocess use in application source
libacl not mapped after application/runtime imports
no privileged caller or privilege-gaining executable
high_assessment.residual: libacl remains installed for base OS utilities; reassess if privileged helpers or ACL functionality are introduced

evidence: Archive::Tar import failed in pre-hardening image
no Archive/Tar.pm under /usr in hardened image
high_assessment.residual: perl-base retains a source-package version match; installing Archive::Tar invalidates assessment
